newsitem.title: RUSSIA: World Bank to advise on Russia's Rosgosstrakh sale.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to advise on Russia's Rosgosstrakh sale.

text.p: The World Bank will choose the consultants who are brought in to advise the government on the sales of its biggest insurer OAO Rosgosstrakh, State Property Committee chairman Alfred Kokh said on Thursday.
He told a news conference that the World Bank had expressed a wish to help in the sales of four Russian companies, including the Mosfilm film studio.
"We have agreed on two projects," Kokh said. "We are to discuss two more projects." He did not specify which two projects had already been agreed.
The government plans to sell 50 percent of Rosgosstrakh at a cash auction this year.
